title: 外滩清晨六点，上海还没醒｜Dawn at the Bund 上海
description:
清晨六点，外滩还没醒，黄浦江面浮着一层薄雾。五十二栋老建筑沿着江岸一字排开——人们叫它「万国建筑博览群」，一条约一点五公里的江岸，收着二十世纪初到一九三零年代的世界建筑。江风一吹，一百年前的上海滩，慢慢亮了起来。老上海人只轻轻说一句——侬好，早。

Six in the morning, and the Bund is still asleep, a thin mist over the Huangpu River. Fifty-odd historic buildings line the water in styles from the early 1900s to the 1930s — the stretch is nicknamed the "Exhibition of International Architecture." As the river wind picks up, old Shanghai slowly lights up. A Shanghai local greets it softly: nong hao — good morning.
